description: The Stock Transfers list. Answers 'what transfers are open', 'what is still in transit', 'did the warehouse send those yet'. Each row is ONE LEG: a move between outlets produces a send-transfer (already completed — the stock has left the source) and a receive-transfer (in-transit until the destination confirms). receive-stock is stock booked in from a supplier; bulk-edit is a recount. To find work that is still open, filter status "in-transit". Search matches the transfer number and the invoice only — not product names. Rows carry no line items: open one with get_stock_transfer to see what was actually moved.

outletIds.description: Only legs at these outlets (ids from get_outlets)

search.description: Matches the transfer number or the invoice number

type.description: Only this leg type. Omit for all
